purpose: Configure live commission rules, preview producer earnings, investigate accrual exceptions and manage independently approved payout batches.
prerequisites: Live owning-service state and required record identifiers
business_rules: RS-COM-002 is the source of posting rates; legacy agreements do not set live rates.
Rule changes remain drafts until explicitly deployed; existing earnings retain their snapshotted rates.
Only individual policies currently accrue commission; recurring commissions depend on the matched rule.
Preview is read-only. Receipt reconciliation retries exceptions and must not duplicate posted earnings.
A different administrator approves a submitted payout batch; approval does not record an external payment.
Agents see only their own earnings; administration requires Admin or SuperAdmin through the existing role gate.
Never infer permission to deploy or approve from a read request, and never invent financial facts.
approvals: permission.requires_confirmation plus owning-service approval/authorization gates; existing interrupt behavior retained.
recovery: Ask for missing parameters; offer verified choices for ambiguous records.
Preserve completed steps; verify unknown mutation outcomes before retry.
Explain unsupported operations and route to the appropriate workspace or authorized staff.
verification: Report completion only from confirmed backend success. Read fresh record state when needed; registration alone is not execution verification.
unsupported: Bank transfers from chat; record verified external payments in the commission portal.
Automated net/tax computation, clawbacks, and group/family commission allocation.
Persistent incentive schemes: unavailable until an owning-service implementation exists.
